controls.description: One unrelated NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day text per target company per split. Fifteen distinct dated source items; no copied prior synthetic controls.

source_policy.title_stratification: Before any return acquisition, prioritize hard adverse-action titles (layoffs, restructuring, restrictions, termination, losses, decline) within seven-day blocks, then other risk/policy titles, then financial results, then other news. Reserve one risk-oriented and one financial-results article in each company/split where such sources exist, choosing by seeded hash; fill other slots with the original deterministic evenly spaced dates. This uses text-side categories only, never returns or expected price directions. Empty strata are reported and filled from dated candidates before freeze.
source_policy.selection: Discover all listed primary-source archive pages for 2023-2025 (bounded 100 pages/year; Apple 100 global pages). Sort source date then URL; collapse each issuer's releases within seven calendar days into a block, choosing the smallest seeded SHA256 URL within the block. This conservative grouping treats a week of releases as one event. Remove legacy source URLs and NVIDIA dates within seven days of old cases. In each company/split select deterministic evenly spaced ranks across the remaining dated blocks, over-requesting only as needed for fixed text-quality exclusions. No return, future price, semantic expected answer, or Jev prediction is used in selection.
source_policy.text: Extract the publisher's article body or an explicitly labeled leading excerpt, capped at 10000 characters on a paragraph boundary. Minimum 350 characters for issuer articles, 150 for NASA controls. No generated summaries. Preserve raw HTML, extracted-text hash, retrieval time, displayed publication date/time, modified time when available, and extraction selector.
source_policy.date_cutoff: 23:59:59 America/New_York on displayed publication date, even when exact time is available. This conservative date-only convention does not prove historical text fidelity. first_observed_at is today's actual retrieval, never backdated.
source_policy.company_context: Fixed minimal business descriptions written before labeling, supported by the companies' own newsroom/IR identification. No current fundamentals, forecasts, valuations, or analyst expectations are invented.
exclusions: duplicate canonical URL or article-text hash
previously inspected legacy URL or nearby NVIDIA case date
purge earlier-split cases whose fifth-session label window reaches the next split start
source_policy.replacements: Only inaccessible/invalid text candidates may be replaced deterministically before dataset freeze and before any new return download. After freeze no case is replaced or removed: missing prices, split windows and failed forecasts remain reported.

target.calendar: XNYS from exchange_calendars 4.12; all five equities are US listed with aligned regular US sessions
target.entry: First regular session opening timestamp strictly after cutoff
target.exit: Fifth regular session closing price, counting entry as session one
target.prices: Yahoo Finance via yfinance 0.2.66; auto_adjust=False, actions=True, repair=False. Archive downloads. Use vendor split-adjusted Open and Close, excluding cash dividends; exclude from scoring any window with a reported split (no replacement). Market features use only observations with session close <= cutoff, and only ratios/volatility, so rescaling historical price units does not change them.
target.missing: No forward filling, interpolating or inventing bars. A missing entry or exit, nonpositive/nonfinite price, missing pre-cutoff history, or split window gets an explicit status and remains in coverage accounting. Target scoring and market-feature eligibility are separate.
target.interpretation: Subsequent raw price movement after the next opening; not the initial announcement reaction, causal news effect, dividend-inclusive return or simulated trading profit.

evaluation.primary: Mean sum over all three classes of (probability - one_hot_label)^2; range 0-2; lower is better
secondary: balanced accuracy over represented actual classes
evaluation.failed_forecasts: Do not fabricate probabilities. Report covered-case Brier and accuracy plus coverage. For validation ranking, assign loss 2 to an unreturned/invalid forecast with an available label, so failures cannot improve selection by hiding difficult cases.
evaluation.abstention: Separate policy only: accept a valid forecast iff maximum class probability >= 0.60. Report coverage, conditional accuracy and Brier separately; flat is never abstention.
baselines: market-only regularized multinomial logistic regression, C=0.1
evaluation.fit: Median imputation and standardization fitted on training only. LogisticRegression C=0.1, max_iter=2000, random_state=1701, no class weighting. Candidate stronger shrinkage uses C=0.01. No model is refit on validation before final testing; all fitted predictors remain training-only.
evaluation.final: During development only training and validation labels are created/read. Select best Jev strategy by failure-penalized validation Brier, resolve ties by earlier iteration. Freeze selection, model artifacts/configuration, source hashes and prediction code. Then acquire test-window prices and evaluate predeclared baselines plus selected Jev strategy and its matched no-Jev ablation in one final pass. No tuning after final results.

response_policy.identity: Exact jev-1.13.0 response model; existing typed-response validator reused after explicit version verification
response_policy.validation: All required question IDs/types, finite values, complete exact class keys, probabilities in [0,1] summing to one within 1e-6, highest-probability choice, valid usage. Never normalize rejected answers.
response_policy.retry: At most three identical-request attempts for invalid response, HTTP 429/5xx or transport failure. Backoff 2 then 5 seconds; respect Retry-After up to 60 seconds. Stop auth/permission or other 4xx immediately. Archive every request and raw response/error; no retry based on correctness or confidence.
response_policy.caching: SHA256 of exact model,state,questions. Reuse completed validated responses, including unchanged stage judgments. Failed requests retain their attempt history and are not automatically reset by restarting.

planned_candidates.change: Remove the three intermediary calls; retain the legacy final forecast prompt and the same source/context
Blend single-direct probabilities 50/50 with training empirical class frequencies to reduce overconfidence; no extra Jev calls
Use atomic Jev economic/evidence features alongside the unchanged market-only logistic predictor, C=0.1; compare exactly the same model without Jev features
Change only logistic regularization to C=0.01; record matched market-only C=0.01 ablation

historical_caveats: Present-day retrieved article versions may contain later changes even when their displayed publication dates are old
Jev may have learned these events or outcomes during training
Issuer newsrooms are promotional and not a representative independent-news corpus
Five companies, 150 intended cases and a small final split permit only exploratory conclusions
Cross-company events may share macro/industry exposure despite conservative source grouping
Source accessibility and surviving archived pages can create selection bias
Yahoo historical prices may be revised; all data vintages are recorded
